holidays.name: National Mutt Day
holidays.description: A day to cheer for mixed-breed dogs. These one-of-a-kind pups come in every shape, size and fluffiness level. Celebrate by hugging a mutt, sharing their photos, or adopting one from a shelter.
holidays.origin: It is an unofficial observance started by pet and animal welfare advocates to encourage the adoption of mixed-breed dogs. Many of these dogs wait a long time in shelters.
holidays.funFact: Mutt Day happens twice a year. It also appears on December 2, so mixed-breed dogs get a bonus celebration.

holidays.name: National Jump for Jelly Beans Day
holidays.description: A bouncy, sugary day for jelly bean fans. Fill a bowl, hunt for your favorite flavor, and leap into the sweetness. Bonus points for brave tastes like buttered popcorn or toasted marshmallow.
holidays.origin: This is an unofficial food observance of unclear origin. It gives candy lovers a reason to enjoy these chewy treats in the middle of summer, long after Easter baskets are empty.
holidays.funFact: Jelly beans are best known as an Easter candy. Their hard candy shell is made through a slow process called panning, which builds up many thin layers.

holidays.name: Harry Potter's Birthday
holidays.description: Fans of the wizarding world celebrate the birthday of the boy who lived. Expect butterbeer, themed movie marathons, house-colored outfits and a lot of wand waving.
holidays.origin: In the books, Harry Potter was born on July 31. That is also author J.K. Rowling's birthday, and she gave the date to her hero. Fans have celebrated it ever since.
holidays.funFact: Harry shares his birthday with his creator. J.K. Rowling was born on July 31, 1965.
